# Configurator Test Instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md), [PROJECTS.md](../../PROJECTS.md) and the
[canonical test rule](../../.agents/rules/tests.md); its byte-identical OmO twin
binds the same paths. The canonical rule owns independent expected-value oracles,
public-seam mock boundaries, invariant disposition, deterministic async signals,
bUnit DOM re-query/renderer interactions, pre-existing-failure quarantine and
phase-scoped verification. [TESTING.md](../../docs/internal/TESTING.md) is the
technical anchor. Do not replace these mechanisms with source/prose inventories
or run an Event provider matrix.
